title: Some Answered Questions
textType: Authoritative text and recorded talk of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá
author: abdul-baha
attributionNote: Some Answered Questions, by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá shelf.
description: A collection of transcriptions of table talks given by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá in ‘Akká between 1904 and 1906 in response to questions posed by Laura Dreyfus-Barney, an American Bahá’í resident in Paris, and first published in 1908. The new edition, extensively retranslated, was published in 2014. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (‘Abdu’l‑Bahá).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
